model_view.reason: Native standard, exact named, and isolated explicit-basis model-view creation is transactionally saved and verified after both transaction-owned and independent read-only reopen on SolidWorks 2025 SP5. Live coverage includes all nine standard orientations, roll, display/style readback, deterministic handles, sheet contract persistence, source-model cleanliness, and temporary-view cleanup.

projected_view.reason: Native projected-view creation with unique parent selection, inherited scale/configuration, deterministic naming, persisted parent relation, and full readback is verified after transaction-owned and independent read-only reopen on SolidWorks 2025 SP5.

full_section.reason: Native full sections support authoritative explicit model-space endpoints plus an independent section-direction vector; the executor validates the parent plane, transforms the cut to sheet space, maps direction without feature heuristics, and reports planned/actual placement. Legacy through_feature_axes plans remain derived, using feature axes only for the cutting plane and the parent outline center for along-line placement. Both modes retain transactional parent, label, segment, alignment, geometry, scale, depth, position-tolerance, and read-only-reopen verification on SolidWorks 2025 SP5.

half_section.reason: Explicit perpendicular half-section paths are created natively and verified with partial-section, parent, label, segment, alignment, normalized geometry, scale, depth, and persisted readback on SolidWorks 2025 SP5.

offset_section.reason: Explicit offset paths must intersect every frozen feature axis before COM and are natively created with exact segment-count and normalized persisted readback on SolidWorks 2025 SP5.

aligned_section.reason: Non-collinear aligned-section paths are natively created and verified with IDrSection.IsAligned, exact label and parent, layout alignment, normalized geometry, and persisted readback on SolidWorks 2025 SP5.

broken_out_section.reason: Native model-orientation broken-out sections use a frozen circular boundary and exact depth through CreateBreakOutSection. The transaction verifies view type, boundary center/radius/axis, feature count/type, depth, persistent handle, placement, scale, and stable normalized fingerprints before save, after close/read-only reopen, and during independent verification on SolidWorks 2025 SP5; unsupported reverse direction fails before COM.

removed_section.reason: Removed sections use mandatory not-aligned placement and are natively verified by exact parent, label, single-segment geometry, alignment zero, scale, depth semantics, and persisted readback on SolidWorks 2025 SP5.

detail_view.reason: Native parent-derived circular detail views use CreateDetailViewAt4 with strict five-style/three-show-type mappings and exact label, outline, scale, profile, parent, placement, and persistent-handle readback. Standard, jagged-outline, and explicit-label-position live cases passed save/close/read-only-reopen and independent verification on SolidWorks 2025 SP5. Explicit label placement uses bounded native direction/readback inversion and still rejects any coordinate SolidWorks cannot reproduce within the frozen tolerance.

auxiliary_view.reason: Native auxiliary views uniquely resolve a frozen visible linear edge in the parent, create through CreateAuxiliaryViewAt2, and verify parent linkage, alignment, scale, flip orientation, exact reference geometry, persistent handle, and normalized rotation across save/close/read-only-reopen on SolidWorks 2025 SP5. Document-default projection-arrow labels remain native. Explicit labels use a deterministic leaderless parent-view-owned INote after clearing the non-positionable native arrow text; the managed label preserves the native view-arrow text format and is verified by exact owner, name, visibility, text, position, and normalized fingerprint. SolidWorks ignores show_arrow=false and exposes no visibility setter, so hidden arrows remain capability-blocked before COM.

center_marks.reason: Feature IDs are resolved uniquely from the hash-verified geometry report to visible native circular edges before mutation. Native single, linear-group, and circular-group center marks use strict style/count/default/show-lines/propagate/slot/color readback, reject SolidWorks style degradation, detect unplanned marks, and persist through transaction-owned and independent read-only reopen on SolidWorks 2025 SP5. Live C4 coverage proves a two-feature linear group with one native group object and two projected centers.

symmetry_centerlines.reason: Horizontal and vertical symmetry centerlines resolve a unique outermost opposed visible linear-edge pair under frozen axis, minimum-span, overlap, and symmetry constraints, then create native attached centerlines with exact color and attached-edge geometry readback. Unplanned lines and equally outermost ambiguity fail closed. Both axes passed save/close/read-only-reopen and independent verification on SolidWorks 2025 SP5.

view_labels.reason: Frozen section labels, document-default and explicit detail labels, document-default auxiliary projection-arrow labels, and explicit repository-managed auxiliary arrow labels are read back exactly in memory, after transaction-owned reopen, and during independent verification. Explicit detail placement and parent-view-owned leaderless auxiliary label placement are live on SolidWorks 2025 SP5; managed auxiliary labels copy the native arrow text format and never substitute a default position for an explicit coordinate.
